snippets.text: FTC Chairman Andrew Ferguson said he resists treating AI agents as autonomous actors with "wills and desires," suggesting liability should fall on developers instead, Reuters reported.

Google is testing "Call for Me," which lets Gemini phone businesses to make reservations or check availability, with a live transcript so the user can monitor or step in, starting with US Pixel 11 owners.

Google plans to launch an experimental orbital AI data center on October 1 carrying four TPUs and 1,000 watts of solar power, though heat limits continuous runs to about 15 minutes, Tom's Hardware reported.
OpenAI's Codex went down for roughly an hour Thursday, engineer Tibo Sottiaux said on X, with Hugging Face's Vaibhav Srivastav later posting that the service was back online.
OpenAI redesigned the ChatGPT desktop app with a new sidebar separated from chat history and an overall visual refresh, TestingCatalog reported.
A new paper describes Jev-Mem, an agent memory architecture that builds memory 6.6 times faster and cuts query latency 36.7%, scoring 0.777 on the LoCoMo benchmark, researcher Elvis Saravia said.
TestingCatalog said Anthropic is building a new Claude Code layout for Claude Desktop, with an updated model selector and an expandable usage-limits section, unconfirmed until Anthropic ships it.
Vals AI ran Claude Opus 5.5, GPT-6 Sol, GPT-6 Luna, Grok 4.7 and MiMo V2.6 through its benchmark index after what it called a big week of model releases.
SemiAnalysis said it is publishing a free teardown of Apple's M6 chip and TSMC's N2 process, covering three GAAFET foundries and its scaling choices.
SemiAnalysis said its ClusterMAX 3.0 testing focused on GPU cloud reliability, measuring how providers detect failures and recover to sustain steady throughput.
New labor-market data shows "no evidence of any significant, widespread displacement or reduction in hiring" of new graduates, countering fears that AI would hit them hardest, Ars Technica reported.
New Jersey fined a Microsoft-linked AI data center a record $1.07 million for running 62 unpermitted power generators and gave it a 45-day shutdown deadline, Tom's Hardware reported.
OpenAI and its co-defendants asked a court to strike two of five new expert declarations Apple filed in their trade-secrets case, calling the 126-page filing improper, 9to5Mac reported.
Xiaomi's MiMo team open-sourced reinforcement-learning training environments and code for MiMo-V2.6 on GitHub and Hugging Face, researcher Elie Bakouch said.
Claude Opus 5.5 cut em dashes 95% and semicolons 73% per 1,000 words while writing 6% longer answers than its predecessor, researcher Rohan Paul said, citing his own text analysis.
SemiAnalysis said it probed DeepSeek V4.1 Flash's memory using the game Ace Attorney: Wright, finding the model's recall of the title extends well beyond names and plot facts.

China is moving faster than Korea toward mass-producing glass substrates for advanced chip packaging even though the two countries sit at a similar technical level, The Elec reported, cited by analyst jukan05 on X.
General Robotics is building modular, specialized AI capabilities rather than one all-purpose robot brain, aiming to help robots adapt across tasks and forms, The Robot Report says.
Claude usage on Theo's T3 Code has overtaken OpenAI's Codex roughly 2-to-1, up from trailing it two weeks earlier, developer Theo said on X.
Apple released macOS 27 "Golden Gate" to the public, headlined by Siri AI along with new Apple Intelligence features across several of Apple's own Mac apps, 9to5Mac reports.
GitHub Copilot's app now lets beginners describe a workflow in plain English and have an agent build a live canvas interface for it, GitHub's blog says.
Amazon will invest $100 million in a new Indiana manufacturing facility to build products for its fulfillment and robotics network across North America, The Robot Report says.

A developer built a single-function, Jev-like wrapper that reads LLM and vision-model token probabilities to answer multiple-choice questions instead of generating full text, trending on the Hacker News front page.
OpenAI's Codex outage has ended, and paid usage limits have reset across Codex and ChatGPT Work, TestingCatalog said.

Anthropic investor Joe Lonsdale said OpenAI and Anthropic are pushing an "oligopoly that controls all of our policy," warning that existential-risk campaigns could entrench the leading labs, Reuters reported.
John Gruber called Meta's Muse "technically groundbreaking" for giving each user a persistent cloud Linux VM, but said its easy packaging may hide how much power it hands users, Simon Willison noted.
